parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path of the parameter. For example, if the name of a parameter is /path/path1/Myparameter, the path of the parameter is /path/path1/.

parameters.name: Recursive
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to recursively query encryption parameters from all levels of directories in the specified path. Valid values: true and false. For example, if you want to query the /secretParameter/mySecretParameter and /secretParameter/secretParameter 1/mySecretParameter parameters, the valid values specify the parameters to be returned.

*   true: returns both of the /secretParameter/mySecretParameter and /secretParameter/secretParameter1/mySecretParameter parameters.
*   false: returns only the /secretParameter/mySecretParameter parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos get-parameters-by-path --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --path /parameter --recursive false --next-token MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzA --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos GetParametersByPath --region cn-hangzhou --Path '/parameter' --NextToken MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzA --MaxResults 10 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Recursive false
